title_tag: 苹果2026发布会炸了：第一台折叠iPhone来了：卖到1.6万元，凭什么？—— 美国《华尔街日报》外刊讲解第1164天
h1: 苹果2026发布会炸了：第一台折叠iPhone来了：卖到1.6万元，凭什么？
category: 华尔街日报外刊讲解 第1164天
nav_hint: Apple Debuts New Foldable iPhone Duo

headline.en_html: Apple Debuts New Foldable iPhone Duo, — New CEO and New (Higher) Prices
headline.zh: 苹果发布全新折叠屏 iPhone Duo，迎来新 CEO，也带来更高的价格

notes.en: to appear or be introduced for the first time in public
notes.ctx: 标题里指苹果在发布会上首次公开推出折叠屏 iPhone Duo，即这款产品第一次正式登场。
notes.ex1: The company will debut its electric pickup truck at the auto show next month. 该公司将在下个月的汽车展上首次推出其电动皮卡。
notes.ex2: She debuted as a director with a low-budget film that won critical praise. 她以一部低成本电影首次以导演身份亮相，并获得评论界好评。

paragraphs.en_html: Apple <mark class="voc">kicked off</mark> its most <mark class="voc">consequential</mark> product event in years on Wednesday, where it introduced a truly new iPhone, a new chief executive, as well as higher prices. It hopes consumers will concentrate on the first two. The headline is the first foldable iPhone, which will start at $1,999. An almost <mark class="voc">tablet</mark>-like device, the new iPhone Duo will fit comfortably in a pocket and allows people to use more than one app at a time. It <mark class="voc">comes in</mark> two colors: white and dark gray.
paragraphs.zh: 苹果周三拉开了多年来最具分量的一场产品发布会的序幕。在这场发布会上，苹果推出了一款真正意义上的全新 iPhone，迎来了一位新任首席执行官，同时也提高了产品价格。苹果希望消费者把注意力集中在前两件事上。此次发布会最大的焦点，是苹果首款折叠屏 iPhone，起售价为 1,999 美元。全新的 iPhone Duo 展开后几乎就像一台平板电脑，却又能轻松放进口袋，同时允许用户一次使用多个应用程序。它提供两种配色：白色和深灰色。

notes.en: to begin an event, activity, or process
notes.ctx: 指苹果用这场发布会正式启动秋季新品活动，是整场发布会的开场动作。
notes.ex1: The festival will kick off with a free concert in the city square. 音乐节将以城市广场的一场免费音乐会拉开序幕。
notes.ex2: The CEO kicked off the meeting by thanking the team for its hard work. CEO 以感谢团队的辛勤工作开始了会议。

notes.en: important and likely to have significant effects
notes.zh: 重要的，具有重大影响的
notes.ctx: 形容这场发布会是苹果多年来影响最大的一次，分量不止于“重要”，而是会带来长远后果。
notes.ex1: The court's ruling was consequential for the entire technology industry. 法院的裁决对整个科技行业都具有重大影响。
notes.ex2: Climate policy is one of the most consequential issues facing this generation. 气候政策是这一代人面临的最具重大影响的议题之一。

notes.en: a flat, portable computer with a touchscreen, larger than a smartphone
notes.ctx: 指 iPhone Duo 展开后的形态介于手机和平板之间，接近一台能放进口袋的平板。
notes.ex1: She reads digital magazines on her tablet during the commute. 她通勤时用平板电脑看电子杂志。
notes.ex2: The new tablet is thin enough to slip into a backpack but powerful enough for video editing. 这款新平板薄到可以塞进背包，性能却足以剪辑视频。

notes.en: used to say what colors, sizes, or styles something is available in
notes.zh: 有……可供选择（颜色、尺寸、款式等）
notes.ctx: 文中用来交代 iPhone Duo 只有白色和深灰色两种配色可选。
notes.ex1: The jacket comes in black, navy, and olive green. 这款夹克有黑色、藏青色和橄榄绿色可选。
notes.ex2: This laptop comes in two sizes, a 13-inch and a 15-inch model. 这款笔记本电脑有两种尺寸可选：13 英寸和 15 英寸。

paragraphs.en_html: Equally important was the man introducing it. John Ternus <mark class="voc">took over</mark> as Apple's CEO last week, becoming Apple's third CEO since 1997, when Steve Jobs returned. Hopes are high that the longtime hardware engineering executive can <mark class="voc">spark</mark> a new wave of innovation and the foldable iPhone is the most significant Apple device in a decade. Ternus smiled broadly as he <mark class="voc">strode</mark> on stage at Apple's headquarters to kick off the event. "We've been imagining quite a lot," he said to the hundreds of gathered media in the audience. "We think you're going to like what you're going to see." Tim Cook and the rest of Apple's executive team sat in the front as he spoke.
paragraphs.zh: 同样重要的，还有站在台上介绍这款产品的人。约翰·特努斯上周刚刚接任苹果 CEO，成为自 1997 年史蒂夫·乔布斯回归苹果以来的第三位首席执行官。外界对这位长期负责硬件工程的高管寄予厚望，希望他能够开启苹果新一轮的创新浪潮，而这款折叠屏 iPhone 则是苹果十年来最具分量的一款设备。特努斯大步走上苹果总部的发布会舞台时满面笑容，为整场活动揭开序幕。“我们一直在构想很多东西，”他对现场数百名媒体人士说道，“我们觉得，你们会喜欢接下来看到的东西。”他说话时，蒂姆·库克和苹果其他高管都坐在前排。

notes.en: to begin to have control of or responsibility for something
notes.ctx: 指特努斯上周从库克手里接过苹果 CEO 一职，成为新任掌门。
notes.ex1: She took over as head of the department when her predecessor retired. 前任退休后，她接任了部门主管一职。
notes.ex2: A rival firm took over the struggling startup last year. 一家竞争对手公司去年接管了这家陷入困境的初创企业。

notes.en: to cause something to start or develop, especially suddenly
notes.ctx: 外界期待这位硬件工程出身的新 CEO 能引爆苹果新一轮创新浪潮。
notes.ex1: The discovery sparked a renewed interest in space exploration. 这一发现重新点燃了人们对太空探索的兴趣。
notes.ex2: His speech sparked a heated debate about education reform. 他的演讲引发了一场关于教育改革的激烈辩论。

notes.en: to walk with long, confident steps
notes.ctx: 写特努斯登台时的步态，用步伐带出他初次以 CEO 身份亮相的自信。
notes.ex1: He strode across the stage and grabbed the microphone. 他大步走过舞台，抓起麦克风。
notes.ex2: She strode into the office, clearly determined to settle the matter. 她大步走进办公室，显然决心要解决这件事。

paragraphs.en_html: The bad news for consumers was that Apple increased iPhone prices, though not <mark class="voc">as much as</mark> some analysts <mark class="voc">projected</mark>. The cost of memory and storage chips inside the smartphone has <mark class="voc">quintupled</mark> since last fall, <mark class="voc">prompting</mark> Apple to raise prices across its device <mark class="voc">lineup</mark> to protect its <mark class="voc">profit margins</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 对消费者来说，坏消息是苹果提高了 iPhone 的价格，尽管涨幅并没有一些分析师此前预计的那么大。自去年秋季以来，智能手机内部使用的内存和存储芯片成本已经上涨至原来的五倍，这促使苹果全面上调旗下设备的价格，以保护其利润率。

notes.en: used to say that an amount is not as large as expected or stated
notes.ctx: 文中用 not as much as 说明实际涨幅低于分析师此前的预测。
notes.ex1: The storm didn't cause as much damage as forecasters had feared. 这场风暴造成的破坏没有预报员担心的那么严重。
notes.ex2: She doesn't earn as much as her colleagues, even though she works longer hours. 尽管她工作时间更长，但收入并不如同事多。

notes.en: to estimate or predict something based on available information
notes.ctx: 指分析师依据现有数据预先估算出的涨价幅度。
notes.ex1: Economists project that inflation will slow down by the end of the year. 经济学家预计通胀将在年底前放缓。
notes.ex2: The company projects sales of two million units in the first quarter. 该公司预计第一季度销量将达到两百万台。

notes.en: to increase five times, or to make something five times larger
notes.ctx: 指手机里的内存与存储芯片成本自去年秋天起涨到原来的五倍。
notes.ex1: The price of the raw material quintupled in less than two years. 这种原材料的价格在不到两年内涨到了原来的五倍。
notes.ex2: The company quintupled its production capacity after opening three new factories. 开设三家新工厂后，该公司将产能提升至原来的五倍。

notes.en: to cause someone to do something, or to cause something to happen
notes.ctx: 芯片涨价成了苹果全线上调售价的直接诱因。
notes.ex1: The sharp rise in fuel costs prompted airlines to raise ticket prices. 燃油成本大幅上涨促使航空公司提高票价。
notes.ex2: Her comments prompted an angry response from the audience. 她的言论引起了观众的愤怒回应。

notes.en: the range of products or the group of people available or offered
notes.ctx: 指苹果旗下在售的全部设备系列，涨价覆盖整条产品线而不只是 iPhone。
notes.ex1: The company refreshed its laptop lineup with faster processors and brighter screens. 该公司以更快的处理器和更亮的屏幕更新了其笔记本电脑产品阵容。
notes.ex2: This year's festival lineup includes several internationally known bands. 今年音乐节的阵容包括几支国际知名乐队。

notes.en: the difference between the cost of producing something and the price at which it is sold
notes.ctx: 苹果宁肯涨价也要守住的那条线，即每卖出一台设备实际赚到的比例。
notes.ex1: Rising labor costs have squeezed profit margins across the industry. 劳动力成本上升挤压了整个行业的利润空间。
notes.ex2: The retailer operates on very thin profit margins to keep prices low. 这家零售商以极薄的利润率运营，以维持低价。

paragraphs.en_html: The highlight of the foldable iPhone Duo is the larger internal screen, which enables iPhone users to have two apps open at the same time. They will be able to watch a video while texting, or look at an email inbox on the left with a message window on the right. Another highlight: the "<mark class="voc">crease</mark>" — where the internal screen folds—is <mark class="voc">effectively</mark> invisible when open, unlike competing Android devices where it can often be noticeable, <mark class="voc">degrading</mark> the consumer experience.
paragraphs.zh: 折叠屏 iPhone Duo 最大的亮点是尺寸更大的内部屏幕，它让 iPhone 用户可以同时打开两个应用程序。用户可以一边观看视频一边发短信，也可以在屏幕左侧查看电子邮件收件箱，同时在右侧打开邮件内容窗口。另一个亮点则是那道“折痕”——也就是内部屏幕折叠的位置——在手机展开后几乎完全看不见；相比之下，在竞争对手的安卓设备上，这道折痕往往相当明显，从而影响用户的使用体验。

notes.en: a line or fold made in something, especially by folding it
notes.ctx: 特指折叠屏内屏对折处留下的那道痕，是折叠机最容易被挑剔的地方。
notes.ex1: He ironed the shirt carefully to remove every crease. 他仔细熨烫衬衫，去掉每一道折痕。
notes.ex2: The map had been folded so many times that a deep crease ran across it. 这张地图被折叠了太多次，中间留下了一道深深的折痕。

notes.en: in a way that produces the intended result; in practice, virtually
notes.ctx: 这里取“实际效果上、几乎”的意思，说展开后那道折痕基本看不出来。
notes.ex1: The new policy effectively bans single-use plastics in all public buildings. 新政策实际上禁止了所有公共建筑内使用一次性塑料制品。
notes.ex2: By fixing the software bug, the team effectively solved the problem overnight. 通过修复软件漏洞，团队一夜之间实际上解决了这个问题。

notes.en: to make something worse in quality or condition
notes.ctx: 指安卓折叠机上那道明显的折痕把使用体验拉低了。
notes.ex1: Poor lighting can degrade the quality of a video call. 光线不佳会降低视频通话的质量。
notes.ex2: Excessive noise degrades the learning environment for students. 过大的噪音会损害学生的学习环境。

paragraphs.en_html: One noticeable <mark class="voc">trade-off</mark> is the device's weight. While thin when unfolded, the Duo's two halves and <mark class="voc">sturdy</mark> construction make it noticeably <mark class="voc">bulkier</mark> than other iPhone models. For its new Pro model phones, Apple emphasized the on-device AI capabilities powered by its upgraded A20 Pro chip, which it said runs faster and <mark class="voc">dissipates</mark> heat more effectively. It also showed off a new variable <mark class="voc">aperture</mark> for the models' camera, that opens and closes automatically depending on the amount of light in the scene, like a human <mark class="voc">pupil</mark> expanding in low light. Apple said the price of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will both jump $100, to $1,199 and $1,299, <mark class="voc">respectively</mark>, compared with last year's 17 Pro. That is not as large a price jump as some feared, and suggests Apple could take a hit on its profit margins for the devices.
paragraphs.zh: 这款设备一个明显的取舍在于重量。虽然展开之后机身很薄，但 Duo 由两个部分组成，再加上坚固的机身结构，使它明显比其他 iPhone 型号更加厚重。对于新款 Pro 系列手机，苹果重点强调了由升级版 A20 Pro 芯片驱动的端侧 AI 功能，并称这款芯片运行速度更快，同时散热效率也更高。苹果还展示了 Pro 系列摄像头全新的可变光圈，它能够根据拍摄环境中的光线多少自动打开或收缩，就像人的瞳孔会在昏暗环境中放大一样。苹果表示，iPhone 18 Pro 和 Pro Max 的价格都将上涨 100 美元，分别达到 1,199 美元和 1,299 美元，高于去年的 iPhone 17 Pro 系列。这一涨幅并没有一些人此前担心的那么大，也意味着苹果可能会在这些设备的利润率上承受一定损失。

notes.en: a balance between two desirable things, where gaining one means losing the other
notes.ctx: 指为了折叠形态和坚固机身，Duo 不得不在重量与厚度上让步。
notes.ex1: There is always a trade-off between battery life and device thickness. 电池续航和设备厚度之间总是存在取舍。
notes.ex2: Working from home offers flexibility, but the trade-off is less face-to-face interaction. 居家办公提供了灵活性，但代价是面对面的交流减少。

notes.en: strong and solid, not easily damaged
notes.ctx: 形容 Duo 机身结构结实耐用，这也是它偏厚重的原因之一。
notes.ex1: The table is made of sturdy oak and will last for decades. 这张桌子由结实的橡木制成，能用几十年。
notes.ex2: You'll need a sturdy pair of boots for hiking in these mountains. 在这些山里徒步，你需要一双结实的靴子。

notes.en: large and heavy, taking up a lot of space
notes.ctx: 指 Duo 合起来后比普通 iPhone 更厚更压手，揣着不如直板机方便。
notes.ex1: The old printer was too bulky to fit on the desk. 那台旧打印机太笨重，放不下桌子。
notes.ex2: Winter coats can be bulky, but they keep you warm. 冬装外套可能很笨重，但能保暖。

notes.en: to gradually disappear, or to make something such as heat disappear
notes.ctx: 说 A20 Pro 把热量散出去的本事更强，长时间使用不容易发烫。
notes.ex1: The fan helps dissipate heat from the processor. 风扇有助于散发处理器产生的热量。
notes.ex2: The morning fog dissipated as the sun rose. 随着太阳升起，晨雾逐渐消散。

notes.en: an opening, especially the hole through which light enters a camera
notes.ctx: 指 Pro 系列摄像头这次能随光线明暗自动开合的进光口。
notes.ex1: A wider aperture lets in more light, which is useful in dim conditions. 更大的光圈能让更多光线进入，在昏暗环境下很有用。
notes.ex2: The photographer adjusted the aperture to blur the background. 摄影师调整光圈以虚化背景。

notes.en: the black circular opening in the center of the eye that controls how much light enters
notes.ctx: 作者拿人眼瞳孔在暗处放大作比，解释光圈为什么要自动调节。
notes.ex1: Your pupils dilate in the dark to let in more light. 在黑暗中，你的瞳孔会放大以让更多光线进入。
notes.ex2: The doctor shone a light into her eye to check her pupils. 医生用光照她的眼睛检查瞳孔。

notes.en: in the same order as the people or things just mentioned
notes.ctx: 用来把 1,199 美元对应 18 Pro、1,299 美元对应 Pro Max，顺序一一对上。
notes.ex1: The first and second prizes went to Tom and Lisa respectively. 一等奖和二等奖分别颁给了汤姆和丽莎。
notes.ex2: Sales in Asia and Europe rose 8% and 5% respectively. 亚洲和欧洲的销售额分别增长了 8% 和 5%。
